subject: general
question: 'Red Light On Gaadi Off' campaign was launched by the government of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Red light on, gaadi off'** initiative will begin in **Delhi from October 18, 2021.**
 
• The campaign will run from 18 October to 18 November 2021.
 
• The campaign was first launched in 2020 to save fuel and reduce air pollution in the city.
 
• The government will deploy** 2,500 Civil Defence Volunteers at 100 intersections under the campaign. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Delhi chief minister has also asked people not to use their personal vehicles at least for one day every week to reduce vehicular pollution.
 
• The campaign was launched by** Delhi Environment Minister Gopal Rai in 2020.**
 
• The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) launched the **second phase of ‘Red Light On, Gaadi Off’ campaign in the national capital.**
 
• Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal had launched the campaign on October 21.
 
• “The campaign was to continue till November 15. However, the Delhi government has decided to extend it till November 30 considering the pollution situation,”
